Research  ·  Financial services AI The customer asks why. Can you answer?

What we are watching in financial services, the obligations already due or coming, and where to start.

SECTOR VIEWUPDATED 26 AUG 2026RESEARCH ONLY
What we are watching

Three questions we ask every organization in this sector.

01

Explaining one decision, months later

When a customer challenges an adverse decision, such as a declined loan or a blocked payment, the institution has to explain that specific decision. That means keeping the inputs, the model version and the reviewer’s notes long enough to answer months later.

02

An inventory that answers two control sets

Most AI inventories are built to satisfy an AI framework alone. We check whether the same register also answers the cybersecurity control set your regulator applies, so one piece of work serves both reviews.

03

Tested on your population, or someone else’s

A model that performs well on a vendor’s benchmark can behave differently with your own customers. We look for evidence that it was tested on your population, with results broken down for the groups the decision affects.

Obligations in force

What is already due, and what is coming.

Each obligation below is externally imposed and shown with its issuing authority and either a date or its current status. Read each one against what your organization could evidence this week, not what it plans to build.

2024KSA · SAMA

Cyber Security Framework and e-KYC framework

Biometric identity proofing for licensed digital banks and payment service providers.

KSA
SINCE JUL 2025CBUAE

Fraud-liability transfer for entities retaining OTP-based authentication

Migration off OTP; 24/7/365 fraud monitoring with device, location and behavior analysis.

UAE
JUL 2025DIFC

Data Protection Amendment No. 1

Private right of action including for distress; processors carry direct liability.

UAE
SEP 2025CBUAE

Decree-Law No. 6 (2025) extends oversight to fintech and crypto firms

Statutory fraud-prevention capability, prompt breach reporting; criminal liability attaches to management negligence.

UAE
27 NOV 2025UAE Cyber Security Council

National Encryption Policy approved

Formally approved post-quantum transition plans; automated cryptographic inventory; crypto-agility.

UAE
1 JAN 2026DIFC Commissioner of Data Protection

Regulation 10 in full enforcement

Documented pre-processing risk assessments, transparency notices, human-oversight design, and either certification or a named Autonomous Systems Officer.

UAE
11 FEB 2026CBUAE

Guidance Note on Consumer Protection and Responsible AI Adoption

Board and senior-management accountability for every AI system deployed; human oversight of high-impact decisions.

UAE
DURING 2026UAE

Mandatory submission of PQC migration plans

A migration plan resting on an inventory you can defend.

UAE
FROM 2026KSA · NCA

NCNICC-1:2025 brings private-sector entities into mandatory scope

Governance, audit, third-party and cloud-provider controls.

KSA
2027SWIFT

SwiftNet 8.0 expected to be PQC-enabled

Participant migration inside a 15-month window.

ALL MARKETS
2028CBUAE

PQC readiness expectation for banks

Migration executed on critical systems.

UAE

In short: AI accountability, fraud controls and post-quantum migration now carry dates in the UAE, and KSA is widening its mandatory scope. How we help institutions meet them is on the Financial services industry page. Last reviewed 26 Aug 2026.
